text:
Raj (Sales): FYI i just uploaded AcmeCorp redlines for MSA + DPA. Main asks: customer-managed HSM, countersign flow for order form, and SLA credit language. PDF attached to thread :paperclip:

Janelle (Legal): thanks. can you call out the exact HSM wording they want? also which clause did they try to change for SLA credits? :eyes:

Raj (Sales): they replaced our SLA section 6.2 with: 'Customer eligible for 25% credit for downtime > 0.1% monthly' — wants stricter credit. HSM ask: "keys must be stored in customer-controlled HSM in EU region; vendor may only request ephemeral wrapping".

Tom (Finance): net60 request on order form from procurement. any objections? that affects cashflow but doable if AM approves.

Aisha (AM): net60 ok for POC but need PO up front. routing: procurement -> finance -> legal -> exec signature. prefer e-sign (DocuSign). If legal needs countersign on order form we should do dual-envelope: MSA (legal) then OrderForm (ops).

Janelle (Legal): Dual-envelope ok. For HSM we can't accept absolute custody demands. propose compromise language: 

```
Customer-managed KMS/HSM: Customer may provision and control KMS keys used to wrap data in transit. Vendor shall not have persistent access to customer key material. Vendor will support attestation of key storage location and configuration on request. Vendor responsibilities regarding key escrow must be limited to temporary, auditable wrapping operations only.
```

That covers their security needs without giving up our operational ability.

Raj (Sales): can we also confirm Private deployment for POC (VPC + dedicated GPU) — they listed Redwood Private in their redline. technical team needs the timeline to ship env before signature.

Aisha (AM): we can provision a POC seat in ~10 business days after PO. I'll add that to the order form notes.

Tom (Finance): put billing contact and PO number fields on the OF. sample snippet: 

```
OrderForm {
  Product: "Redwood Private - POC"
  Term: "1 month trial -> convert to 12mo"
  InvoiceTo: "AcmeCorp, Attn: AP, PO: <PO_NUMBER>"
  PaymentTerms: "Net60"
}
```

Tom (Finance): also need to flag that net60 requires a signed auto-renew opt-in for revenue recognition.

Janelle (Legal): on SLA credits — we can accept an escalated credit bucket but cap at 15% and require incident validation. propose replacing their 25% ask with: 

```
If monthly uptime < 99.9%, Customer may request credits up to 15% of monthly service fees, subject to documented incident reports and validation by Vendor.
```

Janelle (Legal): also need the security questionnaire filled (SOC2 attestation, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS attest). Raj, can you ask them to run through our short sec-qa?

Raj (Sales): on it. i'll send them the checklist and request SOC2 report + HSM attestation doc.

sign-bot: DocuSign envelope created for OrderForm (env_id: 0a9f4c). Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a9f4c (expires in 14 days)

Aisha (AM): great — once legal approves redline i'll route MSA for countersign. if countersign fails for any reason we fallback to single-envelope (MSA + OF together) and wet-ink for exec signature.

Tom (Finance): please cc billing@redwood on the e-sign so AP sees the PO.

Janelle (Legal): i'll respond to their redline with the proposed HSM and SLA compromise. keep me posted if they insist on full custody.

Raj (Sales): will update thread after sec-qa + SOC2 come in. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Aisha (AM): tagging timeline: PO by EOW, POC env in 10 business days after PO, countersign expected within 7 business days after legal ack.

Tom (Finance): acked. :white_check_mark:

sign-bot: Envelope 0a9f4c signed by Customer technical contact (timestamp: 1765441200).

Raj (Sales): awesome — they signed the order form technical acceptance. moving to MSA countersign now.

Janelle (Legal): will finish redline response tonight and send to Raj for handoff. if they reject the 15% cap escalate to me.

Aisha (AM): thanks team. i'll prepare the handoff doc for the ops team so POC provisioning can start as soon as finance confirms invoice.
